Revised final hashes->checkpoint->receipt->checkpoint->print closes the identified budget gap. RSS is sampled, not an OS hard cap; outer remains the full terminal authority.

checks.preparation_only: This review parsed source and read ordinary metadata/raw source bytes only. No reviewed module import/execution, NPZ field decode, observer, mechanics, HP, scientific differences or new media occurred.
